questions.question: A prompt change makes your agent stop running tests, but its answers read just as well. What catches this?
options: An eval with outcome and behaviour checks, compared against a baseline
questions.explanation: Only checks on what the agent did can see it.

questions.question: Why does the tracer go first in the hook list?
options: So it records tool calls even when a later hook, like permissions, blocks them
questions.explanation: The first before_tool that blocks wins; hooks after it never see the call.

questions.question: Why was fix-restock's check changed from file_contains to command_passes?
options: Exact-text checks fail correct fixes written differently; running the tests checks the outcome
questions.explanation: Check the result you care about, not one implementation of it.

questions.question: What does the trace store for a tool result?
options: Its length and a 160-character redacted preview
questions.explanation: Traces shouldn't become a second copy of everything the agent read.

questions.question: The model events record per-call tokens. Why compute a difference?
options: Usage on RunState is cumulative; the difference is what this call cost
questions.explanation: Summing cumulative numbers would wildly overcount.

questions.question: llama3.2 passed 1 of 3 tasks in one run. What's the right next step before comparing it with another model?
options: Run each task several times and report pass rates with the number of runs
questions.explanation: One run of a stochastic system is a sample, not a measurement.
